NXP PN547 NFC controller

Required properties:
- compatible: Must be "nxp,pn547".
- reg: I2C slave address. The driver probes addresses 0x28 through 0x2b.
- interrupts: Rising-edge interrupt generated when receive data is ready.
- nxp,irq_gpio: GPIO connected to the interrupt output.
- nxp,ven: GPIO connected to the enable input.
- nxp,dwld_en: GPIO selecting firmware-download mode.
- nxp,clk_req: GPIO carrying the controller clock request.
- nxp,pvdd_en: GPIO controlling the NFC PVDD enable.
- clocks: Reference to the NFC reference clock.
- clock-names: Must contain "nfc_clk".
- pinctrl-names: Must contain "pn547-active" and "pn547-inactive".
- pinctrl-0: Active pin configuration.
- pinctrl-1: Inactive pin configuration.

Optional properties:
- nxp,dev_name: Misc-device name. Defaults to "pn54x".
- nxp,use_pn544: Apply the PN544 bad-frame receive retry behavior.

Example:
	pn5xx@28 {
		compatible = "nxp,pn547";
		reg = <0x28>;
		interrupts = <92 0>;
		nxp,irq_gpio = <&tlmm 92 0>;
		nxp,ven = <&tlmm 12 0>;
		nxp,dwld_en = <&tlmm 93 0>;
		nxp,clk_req = <&pm8998_gpios 21 0>;
		nxp,pvdd_en = <&tlmm 37 0>;
		clocks = <&clock_rpmcc RPM_SMD_LN_BB_CLK3_PIN>;
		clock-names = "nfc_clk";
		pinctrl-names = "pn547-active", "pn547-inactive";
		pinctrl-0 = <&nfc_int_active &nfc_enable_active
			     &nfc_clk_default>;
		pinctrl-1 = <&nfc_int_suspend &nfc_enable_suspend>;
	};
